summary: The value parser's fallback returned an integer without a representation or span, causing malformed input such as "==\n[._[._" to panic when downstream code required a span. The fix attaches an empty 0..0 span to the fallback integer so parsing can return the syntax error. The fix updates the existing compliance test parse::garbage2 to expect that error instead of a panic. The implementation reversal is derived verbatim from the upstream diff; both regions occur exactly once. Tests were not run.
